title: Rusts fast, not easy to use
text: Rusts fast, not easy to use. Shipping was fast, however, the box it came in was flimsy. I couldn't ever get the apple to line up the right way without taking huge chunks out of it as it spins. The suction was great on it though and it stayed to the counter well. After washing it for the time, it rusted! That was the most disappointing part. I wouldn't recommend this product.
